note: The committed expectation for wire/v1. The companion's Go test asserts the goldens on disk match these counts exactly, so a golden added or deleted without updating this file fails — which is what stops the golden set from quietly thinning out.
opsNote: Call ops carry their own payload schemas under ops/ and goldens under golden/ops/ — not frames, so they sit outside `schemas` and `totals`. A new op adds its row here; the Go test asserts the files on disk match it exactly.
